summary: Fixes jewellery import pivots/fitting, hardens project-mode switching, adds gun base targeting, mode-aware FiveM exports, and optional Discord role login before Studio boot.
notes: Centered transform pivots on imported jewellery so gizmos sit on the model.
Tighter chain fit envelope prevents giant loops around the ped body.
Click empty to deselect; click another model to switch selection immediately.
Clothing project force-opens OBJ clothing tools and never falls back to chain cards.
Gun projects hide the ped and let you select the GTA base weapon target.
FiveM export is mode-aware and includes exact native target naming plus source/textures.
Optional Discord OAuth role gate can protect S5 before boot without changing bot.py.
